The authors suggest a distal AV node focus as the origin of the escape rhythm from the narrow QRS; this is hedged interpretation.
The case text gives heart rate 105 bpm on arrival and 167 bpm on the admission ECG; these are separate measurements and the source does not reconcile them.
The day 3 ECG, echocardiogram and CK sentences follow the day 3 shock sentence but carry no time of their own, and the myocarditis sentence cites a reference placeholder.

The discussion states initial and subsequent troponin levels were normal for all the patients (consistent with the normal initial troponin T reported for Patient 3, but contradicted by the Patient 1 and 2 narratives), and that echocardiography was not suggestive of underlying cardiomyopathy, while Patient 3 had global hypokinesia with ejection fraction 30% and a diagnosis of myocarditis.
The Patient 3 narrative gives the pAO2/FiO2 ratio only in a qualitative statement; no value is printed.

The case text dates the complete heart block "On day 5 of admission to ICU", while the Figure 3(b) caption dates the ECG "on day 5 admission"; the two day counts use different anchors and the source does not say they are the same day.
